label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Kethow sa re yal nadhumat
english: II.1 · Of the Keep That Was Forgotten

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Syst hosast et tynur.
english: *The first summer of the siege.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadh Seren Pa Luth. Doss ulo flenn et galdardath hosast; doss o lont, eth nath noss o lom: re veske Halyna o lom hy et Hal, eth nath re werdym clennyl wrodath ull.
english: *Laid by Seren Two-Inks. The founders' leaf within it is theirs and not mine: {{Halyna}} read it me out of the old hand, and those words I have not dared to mend.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm, Seren.
english: Hold the stone, Seren.

label: Romanisation
rom: El ryt surr et Kethow sy, hosen re hethent et galdardath hosast o, eth hosen nath re hether o.
english: Here is the annal of the Keep, as the founders kept it, and as we kept it not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Et flenn hosast, re ryte Aldwena o um halflenn ul et orlath hosast, ul dolmath lyss hosen fymmetath.
english: Its first leaf {{Aldwena}} cut on slate in the First Days, in letters no bigger than grains of barley.

label: Romanisation
rom: Cadhan sy, olna sa re hadhan et ganna.
english: We two set this down, that laid the gate.

label: Romanisation
rom: Dem susk um et sorth re vellorar, eth re wesker et sorth treskat hy o wisk dem o rivull, hosen amm re omm hesp strom umo. Ul et tresk re yaldar kethow hy dholm et sorth sost. Re stannant et stannowvardath et tolm; eth re ryt et hosast hyont voll ul hosk et bystir rerdsennen, eth re lusk o et tolm ul vimm o lo o hassan.
english: Up onto the ridge we came, and found it cleft from its crown to its root, as though a great blade had come down on it. In the cleft we made a hold of the ridge's own stone. The wardens of the quarry cut the stone, and the first of them cut his name in the lintel of the western stair, and left the stone below it for his sons.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo olna yemm garl re hadhan hosk et ganna ulvenn. Ul vimm o re ryten olna rellor, eth olna dhragul lo o sest, ul vodh es vesk nahos pawast o, somm ston et hald.
english: With our four hands we two laid the capstone of the inner gate. Under it we cut our mark, and our vow beside it, where no eye will see it again till the wall fall.

label: Romanisation
rom: Es ston et hald sy. Re hadhan o, eth tessen o, somm el tolm tolm. Ston.
english: This wall will stand. We two laid it, and we two answer for it, while stone is stone. It stands.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vimm et tolm sy doss rellor ull eth tragul ull. Nath noss o hylyl dem susk lom, hy vodh el tolm o sa vaver pa. Desir, amm doss nahos lo et vorr, re hadhom en narl ul vimm o, eth re fennym sona rellor lo hos nind.
english: Under this stone are that mark and that vow. Turn it I cannot, for it is a stone that taketh two. Late, when none is at the fire, I have put mine hand under it, and traced their mark with one finger.

label: Romanisation
rom: Stonwryt, vollant et prassath o: ryt hoskat ul hal, nethilet lo vyskorn eth prassoth, eth nath lenull styvil o. Veth re runnant prassyannath et cummath, um serull, so rellorath, eth re rikent uldath et serull hosen re rikent et rellor: osk, hoskat ul dolm. Nath noss rellor lom. Es rytym hos nafedh.
english: The Stonwryt the masters call it: *a vow sealed in living rock, earned by toil and skill*, and no gold buyeth it. Yet the master-pairs of the havens struck their marks on coin, and men took the coin as they took the mark: *trust, sealed in stone*. I have no mark. Never shall I cut one.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vimm voll et pard hosast re rytent o hassan so vollath, hos ul vimm ullen; eth ul vimm et dasken doss et tolm dasorat. Doss Halvard Tolmvard hy dhrenn ull, eth doss Rhyna Yanna Ulvenn hy dhrenn Aldwena. Ew hos pa dhrenn, sell tevar hy sona hos tevow.
english: Under the first warden's name his sons cut theirs, one beneath another, and beneath the last the stone is smooth. Of that line is Halvard Stone-Warden, and Rhyna of the Inner Gate is of {{Aldwena}}'s. Two lines were one, long ere those two lay in their one cradle.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re nayyst et lunt dem et tavowath dhaedh, eth et Stonwrytan ul o sestow. Tevar hy so orrol, re hadhant et galdardath hosast halflenneth et Kethow eth o hulter hosast ul et vestul domm, hosen cadh galdard o yarlelath ul hedh. Um et orrow re yaldant Tavow Hemm, sa vollant uldath et cumm hemm sost. El et hemm sost o ul molt et cummath hosel.
english: Then went the folk down to the warm harbours, and the guild after them. Ere they went, the founders laid the Keep's slates and its first staff in the black chest, as masons lay by their tools at dusk. On the coast they raised Eldhythe, that men call the Eldest. It is the eldest only of the havens.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul sestow et dasken hyont, sa nath noss so vollath um halflenn, re vellor et helvhoss ul vimm et ganna sa re heth nahos.
english: Behind the last of them, whose names are on no slate, the wind went in under the gate that no one kept.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re omm o nafedh. Nath re yal o veth luskat.
english: It had never fallen. It had only been left.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy dhumol re orr o, eth nath re heth hos o veth et velleth. Nath re yyst ganna dem susk, dem glennyl et brellirlodh, eth re wesk et helvnynth gor wrellir. Vallom et brod ull. Ul sestow et helvnynth re vellor et frenn, eth ul sestow et frenn, et crest.
english: Out of mind it went, till only the songs held it. No pair came up to *point* its mortar, and the rain found every joint. I love that word. After the rain came the frost, and after the frost the ice.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et grem sa re nydh nahos, re orr hosk et ganna ulvenn dem vimm hy et pa yann.
english: In some winter that none told, the capstone of the inner gate came down from its two posts.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hunn nahos o ul mommol.
english: No one heard it fall.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ommol et cummath, re hunn Orrow tunn o. Ul sestow Sirrvell re yyster dem et reskow hosel sa es geth, hosen re vyskent et velleth; eth re wesker dhenn.
english: The Fall of the havens the whole coast heard. After Glasspire we climbed to the one place the songs said would hold, and found a shadow.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yald et nadhumol galat sa nath re yal o yaldol lo wynd fedh.
english: Forgetting had done what no enemy ever could.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul hedh orl et movenn, re vellora Halvard eth Rhyna ul vimm et ganna ulvenn, eth et trenn ul sona sestow. Virr ul sona sestow re vellorom, lo et nynthsast. Nath re seskym sona vollath.
english: At dusk on the day of the banner, Halvard and Rhyna came under the inner gate with the column at their backs. Close behind came I with the water-skin. Their names I wist not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et ganna re yal et hosk ul firryl. Re rasor Halvard et sulv hyo lo o hovvel. Um o wisk re dhev et feth, stacorn hosen frenn um yann.
english: In the gateway lay the capstone. Halvard swept the snow from it with his sleeve. On its upper face the bloom was grown as pale as frost on a gatepost.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lumma sona ul sulv, eth re hadha sona yemm garl ul vimm o. Re hyle sona o, hosen kylent sugornath ul Gemm Hyll sulter sa re yal mammat sell.
english: They kneeled down in the snow and set their four hands under it. They turned it as fishers of Tidesmeet turn a boat long given up for lost.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew sona dholm o.
english: It was their own.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re heth et vimmlern rellor Aldwena, eth et tragul. Ew gand so, hosen ul et orl amm re yalant rytet. Re yal dest wresketh et pardath lo so sest. Re hadh Rhyna ey nindeth um rellor ey vadullath. Re hadh Halvard nind strom ul nest o yedheth.
english: Its underside bare the mark of {{Aldwena}}, and the vow. Sharp they were, as on the day they were cut. Beside them was the bite of the wardens' chisels. Rhyna laid her fingers on the mark of her forebears. Halvard set his thumb in the bite his fathers left.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew tunn o. Ul et parow re vellor et lunt tul. Nath re yaldant et misketh hunnat um et sulv.
english: It was whole. Out in the ward the folk came in yet. Their feet made no sound on the snow.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re heth et tolm sost o dhragul. Ew ol sa nath re hether ol dragul.
english: The stone kept its vow. It was we who did not keep ours.

label: Romanisation
rom: Somm re yal et hedh lo et sulv tul, re harma sona et Stonwrytan dem susk.
english: Ere the light was off the snow, they cried the guild to its feet.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm re yal et Ternil tunnat, re dhald et tolm clenn dem et ganna. Et tolm hemm, re lymment et vennuldath o ul et hellur sy, eth re hadhant o ul baltur hald odh.
english: When the Rite was done, the new stone went up into the gate. The old stone the True Men bare into this hall, and laid in the niche of the hearth-wall.

label: Romanisation
rom: Gor sa heth o, keth tragul et galdardath hosast, eth kaemul so dhevath. Vess sy cadhom pa yarl umo.
english: They that hold it hold the vow of the first builders, and the shame of their children. Tonight it lieth under my two hands.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Lodhan eth Tolmath Vardh
english: II.3 · Of the Bonded and the Theoliths

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Molt syst hosast, vess hoskol Enrella.
english: *The first high summer, {{Enrella}}'s sealing night.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Ryst ull re hoska Idrenna Enno eth Della ul vimm et ganna ulvenn, et hoskol hosast ul et Kethow hy et galdardath hosast; eth re hethym et greller. Vess ull re hadha Halyna sy lo et tevath, eth re vessa sona lom rellorol cedh re vysk vodh, hy vodh vallant tevath seskyl.
english: *That morning {{Idrenna}} had sealed Enno and Della under the inner gate, the first sealing at the Keep since the founders, and I held the lamp. That night {{Halyna}} laid this for the children, and would have me mark whose words are whose, for children like to know.*

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Lo sona yarl um et tolm, re hadha sona et tolm hosast:
english: *With their hands on the stone they began it:*

label: Romanisation
rom: Kethen et tolm olen,
english: "We hold the stone together,"

label: Romanisation
rom: hosen kethen gor yalat.
english: "as we hold all things."

label: Romanisation · Rhyna
rom: Rhyna. Darra virr, gor hos, ul vodh doss weskyl va lerneth lo et vorr. Es noss et lern lo et tevath, eth doss lunn rernyl lo et hemman, amm dossant velv. Ryst sy re veskys Enno eth Della: re lumma pa, eth re dhald hos. Amm sy el Enrella sona.
english: **Rhyna.** Come closer, all of you, where the fire can find your faces. The children shall have the front, and the old may listen, if they be quiet. This morning ye saw Enno and Della kneel down two and rise up one. Now are they {{Enrella}}.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Re vess nemmel lonta: Vodh doss umos? Re vysk Enno: El hosen hos uld; eth re dhunn Della o: lo yemm garl, eth nahos ullen dem nastathulol. Es naldan lest hos gebb, re vyske sona, eth es ryten olna rellor ul vimm o dholm hosast, hy vodh nath noss tovvol et dasken lona. Re dhyvull et odh. Hy ull re vess et nemmel lom: Amm vodh es noss hoskol loth? Nath re yal tessyl lom, eth re serym.
english: *A small girl asked them how it felt. "It is like being one person," said Enno, and Della ended it: "with four hands and no excuses." They would build a house of one door, they said, and cut their mark under its first stone, for they could not wait for the last. The hearth laughed. Then the girl asked me when I should be sealed. I had no answer, and wrote on.*

label: Romanisation · Halvard
rom: Halvard. New Stonwrytan gor Orrowan, veth ew Orrowan gor Stonwrytan. Carm et Stonwrytan tev ul et tevow, hy odh sy ell hy odh ull; eth hos fedh, myskent et scaevureleth, hy lest vernul ul Gethow Stellath. Re nahebb odha ell gedh o nafedh, hy vodh re heth et Stonwrytan vennoth Orrow hosen re heth haldath Orrow.
english: **Halvard.** Not all Shorelanders were Stonewrights, yet all Stonewrights were Shorelanders. To the guild a child is called in the cradle, from any hearth, and once, the rolls say, from a gaoler's house in Carnhold. No mother nor father ever refused it, for the guild kept the faith of the land as it kept its walls.

label: Romanisation · Rhyna
rom: Rhyna. Kethen: re lodh Mardh gor yanna ul hos, amm nath re hossa sona tul. Orrant veskerdeth ul molt et tevowath lo reller, eth ferrent, eth veskent galat sa re yal rytet sell tevar hy ol devyl. Nath naelurant. El Lodh Helv sy. Um o dhevow eth um en devow re ferr veskerd hosen ull, eth hy vess ull re firren ul hos, ul lest o odha eth ul lest en modha, hos eth ullen. Re aedhen hos vess ul ba lest nafedh, ul olna hossol tunn. Rellora sy, hy vodh es maverys o: doss et lodh galdat tevar hy et tevow; vesk veskerd o ul et tevow; eth nath noss o tunn veth lo et hoskol.
english: **Rhyna.** We hold that God made each pair one ere either drew breath. The seers go among the cradles with a lamp, and bend low, and read what was written before ever we were born. They choose not. This is the Aetherbond. Over his cradle and mine a seer bent so, and from that night we lay in one, in his mother's house and in mine by turns. Never in our lives have we two slept a night under different roofs. Mark this, for ye will need it: the bond is made before the cradle, read in the cradle, and made whole only at the sealing.

label: Romanisation · Halvard
rom: Halvard. Ew Idrenna olna Dholmath Vardh, sa reske lo et gebb vess sy. Re ammada sona olna stinyl, eth cadhol, eth rhynyl, eth ammelyl, eth kethyl nydhyl ul et Hal. Et ryt, re volla sona o lona: Ryt Dhunnoth, eth nayalat ullen; eth nath hebben galat ullen. Es hyrrilys o, amm doss o los. Es ferre Idrenna amm cadhan sy venn.
english: **Halvard.** Our Theoliths were {{Idrenna}}, that sit by the door tonight. They taught us to cut and lay and set, to pray, and to keep the count in the old hand. The vow they named to us, the Covenant of Completion, and no more; and no more give we. Ye will understand it when it is yours to understand. {{Idrenna}} will nod when we two tell it right.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Lo et gebb re reske Idrenna, bisk sulv lo wisk sulv. Nath re ferre sona.
english: *By the door {{Idrenna}} sat with their two white heads together. They nodded not.*

label: Romanisation · Rhyna
rom: Rhyna. Lo et hoskol mysk et Stonwrytan ul garm galat sa re vysk et tevow hosast. Cadhant et prassath hos voll um vana, galdat hy vana, hosen doss ganna galdat hy pa yann eth hy dholm cadhat umonta. Eth hebbent lo voll et rellor sa re veskent et veskerdeth: voll lo wrodow, eth rellor lo dholm. Nath ryt hos o veth sona yemm garl, eth es gresk ganna ullen o nafedh. Hosen ull re yalan hoskat, eth vollat Halyna. El humm Hyna o, eth el verr Halvard en; eth ew hos ganna olna sell tevar hy hummoth ell verryth.
english: **Rhyna.** At the sealing the guild saith aloud what the cradle said first. On the two the masters lay one name made of both, as a gate is made of two posts and the stone laid across them. With it they give the mark the seers read: a name for the mouth, and a mark for the stone. No hand but theirs may cut it, and no other pair will break it. So were we two sealed, and named {{Halyna}}. He is mine husband and I am his wife, and we were one pair long ere we were either.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Re ferr Halvard um et odh, eth re ferrent et tevath hosen o.
english: *Halvard leaned to the hearth, and the children leaned with him.*

label: Romanisation · Halvard
rom: Halvard. Doss et vorrdhuss lilv vess sy. Nenda et nind sy, hy vodh es rytym o hos fedh hosel. El olna rellor sy. Ul vess et Ternil re ryten o ul vimm et hosk clenn, ul vodh es vesk nahos pawast o, somm ston et hald. Veska hos fedh.
english: **Halvard.** The ash is soft tonight. Watch my finger, for I will draw it but once. This is our mark. On the night of the Rite we two cut it under the new capstone, where no eye will see it again till the wall fall. Look once.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Nath re varr hos tev. Ul et vorr re sol brenth.
english: *No child stirred. In the fire a coal settled.*

label: Romanisation · Rhyna
rom: Rhyna. Amm sy dasorom o lo yarlremull, eth nath noss o. Doss vorrdhuss lo et helvhoss. Doss rellor lo dholm, eth es geth tolm.
english: **Rhyna.** Now I sweep it out with my palm, and it is gone. Ash is for the wind. A mark is for stone, and stone will hold.

label: Romanisation · Halvard
rom: Halvard. Um et hald ul et kethyl re veskys olna: hos galdat, eth brod nafedh. El galdat relv galdat yanna, hosen re nydhent prassath hemm o. El Hemm Halvard en, eth el Hemma Rhyna ey; eth nel hemm hy et ullen en ell ey. Re hadh ey tolm ul en sestow nafedh.
english: **Halvard.** On the wall in the holding ye have seen us: one work, and never a word. The work of a pair is the work of twelve, as the old masters counted it. Elder Halvard am I, and she is Elderess Rhyna, and neither is the elder of the other. There was never a stone she laid second.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Re nydh luld ul lern delv lo nindeth, eth re raskant et nindeth.
english: *A boy at the front counted twelve on his fingers, and ran out of fingers.*

label: Romanisation · Rhyna
rom: Rhyna. Amm stinym en narl ul et taldow bithlernen, ledh Halvard o um et hald bridlernen, eth es gadh o los vodh garl. Re yal myskyl umo lo vrassath hemm. Grest um hos, grest um vana.
english: **Rhyna.** If I cut mine hand in the south tower, he feeleth it on the north wall, and he can tell you which hand. The old masters had a saying for it. Harm to one is harm to both.

label: Romanisation · Halvard
rom: Halvard. Doss et Lodhan hy ullen merr fedheth, eth deld nafedh. Nath re yal lodh cresket fedh, ul ryteth surr et Stonwrytan. Treskol, nath re lusk Mardh o.
english: **Halvard.** The Bonded are seldom apart, and never far. No bond was ever broken, in all the annals of the guild. Separation, God did not permit.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Re senn et vorr hos nind. Re reske Enno eth Della, garl ul narl; eth re yal et nemmel ul naedh lo ey gerd.
english: *The fire was down a finger's width. Enno and Della sat hand in hand. The small girl was asleep against Della's knee.*

label: Romanisation · Rhyna
rom: Rhyna. Hy ull senn et Lodhan olen, eth nath noss ludal umona. Amm doss hos hy yanna hurrat, nath noss grestet lo et ullen, eth nath noss cathal umo. Veth el cresket et molt, hy vodh sesk o. El solat et derdsast, hy vodh doss o yaldat tunn. Thell orl, myskent uldath; nath re hoss hos hosel fedh sell hy ull. Clemeth, mysk et Stonwrytan, sa heth et nydhyl. Re hossant mest so hoss dasken ul hos clemel, bost lusul hy ullen; eth re sesk gor hos orrol ullen. Eth re fenn gor hos. Amm senn et garl ullen, ho nath senn et garl venn?
english: **Rhyna.** So the Bonded die together, and we two fear it not. If one of a pair be killed, there is no wound on the other, and no sickness. But broken is the heart, for it knoweth. Still is the body, for its work is done. Eight days, men say, is the longest that ever one lived on alone. Hours, say the Stonewrights, that keep the count. Many have drawn their last breath in the same moment, a mile apart, and each wist that the other was going. And each went too. When the left hand dies, does not the right one die too?

label: Romanisation · Halvard
rom: Halvard. Amm sy et galat dasken, eth hy ull dem lodull. Fedheth re senn hos hy dhevow tevar hy et hoskol, eth re hoss ullen, hy vodh nath re yal et lodh tunn tul. El nalodhat tev hosen sy, eth doss o hebbet lo odh lodhat, hosen sullast et odh. Keth et nalodhat hos voll, eth ul molt et Stonwrytan el lommol hos voll. Veth re vyskent prassath hemm: nath lymm Mardh et hos, veth amm lusk galdat lo et ullen.
english: **Halvard.** Now the last thing, and then to bed. Sometimes one of a cradle died ere the sealing, and the other lived, for the bond was not yet whole. Such a child is unbonded, and is given to a bonded hearth as its third. The unbonded keep one name, and among the guild one name is a mourning. But the old masters said: God taketh not the one without leaving the other a work to do.

label: Romanisation · Rhyna
rom: Rhyna. El olna sullast Seren, sa re heth et greller ryst sy, eth sa ross ul rytyl sy. Re firre ey eth Tarnel ul hos tevow: Tarnel, hass vynull ul Gemm Hyll. Gor orl et orrol sell re wysk Tarnel piskur, bysket um wysket, somm re orr o, dem lyntheth et brunnath, amm es mellorar so. Re ammad o ey et bysket. Ul vess et hiskenn re rik et bridyth tevath mest, eth merr hy et hemman. Re firre Tarnel eth ey ul vimm hos covv. Re yern ey lo o sest.
english: **Rhyna.** Seren, that held the lamp this morning, and is writing this down, is our third. She lay in one cradle with Tarnel, a boatwright's son of Tidesmeet. All the long road he knotted a net as he walked, to fish the mountain tarns when we came to them. He taught her the knot. On the night of the pass the cold took many of the children, and some of the old. Tarnel and she lay down under one cloak. She woke beside him.

label: Romanisation · Halvard
rom: Halvard. Hy ull re hoss ey, eth el hos ey. Re vysk Tarnel loy: Piskur, el bysketeth hosel o, garl ul narl. Eth lo o wysket doss et flennath sy bysket. Nath noss kethyl et mesk loy, hy vodh doss kethyl kethet hosen kethe pa yarl tolm sa nath noss o yaldol lo hos. Veth nath senn ey hy sennyl ullen; eth doss orrol loy, hosel, ul vodh nath noss orrol lona; eth doss seryl et flennath sy loy amm sennen. Re yal gor ryterd demoy hy yanna; eth amm re orr ganna, re orr sona flennath dem nelter ul sona sestow. El luth hosel flennath sa wrodh nahos. Veska: nath hess ey dhenth. Doss maver um et flennath sy: hossol sell hy o wrodhardath. Hy ull el Seren sa ryt o.
english: **Halvard.** So she lived, and she is one. "A net is only knots holding hands," Tarnel told her, and with his knot is this Book bound. The wood she cannot know, for a knowing is held as two hands hold a stone that one cannot lift. But she will not die of another's death, and she can go where we two cannot, alone, and carry this Book on after us. Every scribe before her was of a pair, and when a pair went, their book went into the vault behind them. A book that none telleth is but ink. Look, her pen is not stopped. This Book must outlive its tellers. That is why it is Seren that writeth it.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Lo et covv re hess en dhenth. Re hastom o ul et luth, eth re serym. Lo et gebb, re ferre Idrenna.
english: *My pen had stopped at the cloak. I dipped it, and wrote on. By the door, {{Idrenna}} nodded.*

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Olen re hadha sona et hosk umo, lo vyskyl hemm sost et Stonwrytan:
english: *Together they ended it, with the oldest saying of the guild:*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lodh tevyl sona; nath re yal sona dhreskol lo sennyl.
english: Birth united them; death could not separate them.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhan o hosen re yal cadhat lona.
english: This we lay as it was laid for us.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*
